scope: Channel format viability: 16 sampled uploads across all 12 commentary sources in the inventory.
method: Muted browser streaming, visual early/late samples, auto-caption transcripts, and metadata-only resolution checks. No video/audio files downloaded.
limitations: Not a full watch-through of every sampled upload.
No direct listening, audio quality measurement, ASR benchmark, OCR benchmark or action-recognition test.
Named pro identity comes from source context; account ownership is not independently verified.
No channel-wide approval; unsampled uploads remain metadata candidates.
Historical footage does not establish eligibility for the selected patch cohort.
